text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria. Klebsiella pneumoniae is identified at high colony counts, confirming infection. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts are present. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
